articles.title: ‘Go back to E10 petrol’: Experts warn E20 fuel is increasing household expenditure, reducing food security
articles.description: Experts have raised significant concerns about India's E20 fuel rollout during an Indian Women's Press Corps event, demanding transparency and highlighting potential negative impacts on household finances, food security, and the environment. They argue that consumers face increased vehicle repair costs due to the mildly corrosive nature of E20, adding to their financial burden. The experts also questioned the government's claims of farmer benefits, seeking evidence and suggesting profits primarily favor distilleries. Furthermore, the environmental advantages are debated, with concerns about water usage for rice cultivation for ethanol production and a shift in agricultural focus from food to fuel. Comparisons to Brazil's gradual adoption of ethanol blending were made, suggesting India's rapid implementation is problematic. Ultimately, a return to the E10 fuel blend is recommended for its compatibility with existing vehicles and its perceived broader benefits for consumers and the environment.

articles.title: Oil prices hold steady after jumping 5%, while Asian shares are mixed
articles.description: Shares are mixed in Asia, while oil prices are holding steady after gaining 5% due to questions over when the Strait of Hormuz could reopen and get the global flow of crude going again. On Monday, the S&P 500 slipped 0.1%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 0.1%, and the Nasdaq composite fell 0.3%. Intel weighed on the market after saying it may sell $15 billion of its stock to raise cash to take advantage of the AI frenzy. That helped offset Berkshire Hathaway's gain after it became one of the latest U.S. companies to deliver a better profit for the spring than expected. Brent crude rose 5%.
